description: This file implements the FalSmartTurnAnalyzer class, a subclass of HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer, which integrates Fal.ai's hosted smart-turn model API for end-of-turn detection in conversations. It handles initializing the analyzer with API endpoint URL, API key for authentication, and manages warnings about deprecation.
